system.description:
Favoured weapon: Hammer, War

Granted power: Once/day: bind a target to a sworn oath (Will save negates). The target cannot knowingly break the oath without suffering disadvantage on all rolls for 24 hours. Advantage on Persuasion to enforce contracts. Your Smite binds the target to the duel: it has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until your next turn.
